name: Darwin & Wedgwood — a family of ideas
description: A private historical demo spanning five generations of the Darwin–Wedgwood family. A selected tree, not a complete genealogy. Historical people are profiles, not app accounts. Sources: Cambridge University Library's Darwin Correspondence Project and English Heritage.
